# taxplore: R package for generating and displaying Krona charts

[![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markschl/taxplore/refs/heads/main/inst/taxplore.png)](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore)

This [R](https://cran.r-project.org) package provides functions for
creating [Krona charts](https://github.com/marbl/Krona/wiki) and
displaying/embedding them as [HTML
widget](https://github.com/ramnathv/htmlwidgets) in different contexts
or using them in [Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co) applications.

Krona charts are commonly used as interactive visualizations of the taxa
in metagenomic and metabarcoding (microbiota) samples, but can in
principle be used to visualize all kinds of hierarchical data.

This package and does not require any additional software to be
installed. It aims to be as flexible as possible.

The **snapshot** feature allows embedding chart snapshots in
non-interactive documents such as PDF or Word (see
[tutorial](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/articles/tutorial.html)).

## Installation

To install the R package:

``` r
# install.packages('remotes')
remotes::install_github('markschl/taxplore')
```

The [KronaTools](https://github.com/marbl/Krona/tree/master/KronaTools)
software collection is *not* needed. This package [includes a
copy](#third-party-software) of the Krona JavaScript and is able to
generate charts that are (nearly) identical to the ones generated by
KronaTools.

## Documentation

The documentation is at <https://markschl.github.io/taxplore>.

Two in-depth tutorials are available:

- A general [feature overview and
  tutorial](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/articles/tutorial.html)
- Additional examples with [phyloseq
  datsets](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/articles/phyloseq.html)

## Usage overview

``` r
library(taxplore)
```

There are two main functions:

### make_krona

This function generates Krona charts from hierarchical data in *data
frames/matrices*, *[phyloseq](https://joey711.github.io/phyloseq)
objects* or hierarchical *list data structures*.

Example:

``` r
data(grasslandfungi.records)
make_krona(grasslandfungi.record_tax, outfile = 'krona_chart.html')
```

### plot_krona

Display the hierarchical charts, either as interactive plots launched
from the console, or embedded in
[R-Markdown](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com)/[Quarto](https://quarto.org)
documents or [Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co) applications. It accepts
the same input data as
[`make_krona()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/make_krona.md),
or can be used to display pre-generated charts.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markschl/taxplore/refs/heads/img/example-snapshot-1.png)

## Third-party software

This project includes unmodified copy of some files from
<https://github.com/marbl/Krona>, notably the JavaScript code and images
included in the HTML charts.

In addition, a “minified” version of the script is provided (see
[installation
script](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/scripts/install_krona.R)).
When embedding charts, additional JavaScript code is sometimes injected
for adjusting settings and taking static snapshots (see ).

KRONA is a trademark of its respective owners (see
[KRONA_LICENSE](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/KRONA_LICENSE)).
This project is not affiliated with the Krona authors. The documentation
and some function names still contain “Krona” as a term to describe
these charts.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ChartAttribute()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/ChartAttribute.md)
  : Chart attribute specification
- [`ChartDisplayOpts()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/ChartDisplayOpts.md)
  : Configure the initial chart appearance
- [`ChartOpts()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/ChartOpts.md)
  : General chart options
- [`copy_krona_resources()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/copy_krona_resources.md)
  : Copy chart resources to a specified directory
- [`generate_krona_html()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/generate_krona_html.md)
  : Generates a HTML chart from a character string containing the Krona
  XML.
- [`generate_krona_html_internal()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/generate_krona_html_internal.md)
  : Generate a HTML chart in R
- [`grasslandfungi`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/grasslandfungi.md)
  [`grasslandfungi.records`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/grasslandfungi.md)
  : Grassland fungi survey data
- [`KronaChartOutput()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/krona_chart-shiny.md)
  [`renderKronaChart()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/krona_chart-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for plot_krona
- [`kt_import_xml()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/kt_import_xml.md)
  : Generate a HTML chart using the official Krona tools
- [`make_krona()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/make_krona.md)
  : Generate a chart
- [`plot_krona()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/plot_krona.md)
  : Display a Krona chart as HTML widget
- [`set_chart_display_opts()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/set_chart_display_opts.md)
  : Set global chart display options to override the default
  ChartDisplayOpts.
- [`set_chart_opts()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/set_chart_opts.md)
  : Set global chart options to override the default ChartOpts.
- [`taxplore_configure_snapshot()`](https://markschl.github.io/taxplore/reference/taxplore_configure_snapshot.md)
  : Set sensible Knitr defaults for chart snapshots
